reference.title: Simplify cart CLI and add Claude skills
reference.summary: Reworked the cart-tracking CLI to match the simpler design sketched in ~/claude-task.md and added Claude Code skills that expose carts to agents. Added --json support to ox carts start so the skill can parse the cart title and trigger a /rename of the Claude session to a kebab-case name derived from it. Built four skills — /ox-cart, /ox-cart-start, /ox-cart-done, /ox-cart-drop — placed in both .claude/commands/ and extensions/claude/commands/ so they ship with the CLI. Landed the work on branch ajit-kanban-basecamp-cli (22 files) with an amended commit feat(carts): add DoltDB-backed cart tracking for work items, pushed to origin and ready for PR.
